name: account-ledgers
description: Double-entry bookkeeping app for Japanese sole proprietors and small companies (MVP)

scripts.dev: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-account-ledgers --only auth,firestore,storage --ui "npm run seed && cd packages/web && next dev"
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/domain && tsc --noEmit -p packages/usecases && tsc --noEmit -p packages/infrastructure && tsc --noEmit -p packages/web
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:integration: firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,storage --project demo-account-ledgers "vitest run --project integration --project rules --passWithNoTests"
